acceptance: selects partially overlapped rectangle in overlap mode but not in contain mode: given A rectangle at (0, 0, 100, 100) and a lasso path clipping only its top-left corner, expect Selected elements is empty in "contain" mode and contains the rectangle in "overlap" mode

selects fully enclosed rectangle, diamond, ellipse, rotated shape, line, arrow, and freedraw in contain mode: given Unlocked rectangle, diamond, ellipse, rotated rectangle, line, arrow, and freedraw stroke inside a surrounding lasso polygon in "contain" mode, expect All seven elements are selected

does not select element partially inside a concave lasso polygon in contain mode: given A rectangle whose AABB intersects a concave U-shaped lasso's bounds while part of its outline lies in the concave notch outside the polygon, expect Selected elements is empty in "contain" mode and contains the rectangle in "overlap" mode

requires arrow bound text label to be enclosed in contain mode: given An arrow with a bound text label whose computed label bounds extend beyond the arrow shaft, expect A lasso enclosing only the arrow shaft selects nothing in "contain" mode, while a lasso enclosing both the arrow and its bound label selects the arrow

ignores rectangle bound text label in contain mode while selecting container in overlap mode: given A rectangle with a bound text label and a lasso path completely inside the rectangle that encloses only the bound label, expect Selected elements is empty in "contain" mode and contains the rectangle in "overlap" mode

enforces top-level, nested, off-screen, locked, and bound-text group rules in contain and overlap modes: given Grouped elements including two-member groups, nested inner/outer groups, an off-screen group member, a locked group member, and a bound-text group member, expect In "contain" mode, a group is selected only when all selectable scene members of its top-level group are enclosed (locked and bound-text members do not block); in "overlap" mode, touching one member selects the whole group

preserves frame child exclusion and additive selection in contain mode: given A frame with child elements and a pre-selected element with keepPreviousSelection=true in "contain" mode, expect Enclosing the frame and its children selects only the frame, and keepPreviousSelection=true retains the previously selected element
